newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Poland wants firm date for enlargement talks.
newsitem.headline: Poland wants firm date for enlargement talks.

text.p: Poland would like set a firm date of January 1998 for the state of negotiations to join the European Union to encourage discipline on both sides, Foreign Minister Dariusz Rosati said on Friday.
"We would like it to be de-linked from the IGC issue," Rosati told reporters after a two-day visit to Brussels.

Rosati said he had received assurances from top EU officials that the inter-governmental conference would remain on track, despite some reports before the Dublin European council that it could carry over beyond the end of the Dutch presidency.
Poland and other applicant nations have been told they can begin membership talks six months after the end of the IGC if a favourable report from the European Commission is forthcoming.
